definition.zh-TW: 營業活動淨現金流量相對於流動負債的比率，看本業一年賺進的現金能還多少短期債務。數值越高，短期償債的壓力越小。
definition.en: Net cash from operating activities relative to current liabilities: how much of the short-term debt a year's operating cash could repay. Higher means less pressure on short-term repayment.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
